_comment: Threshold requirements, Alaska GOAL Rating and Award Criteria Plan, version June 24, 2026. The numbered Threshold Requirements on PDF pp.11-16, the pre-application capacity threshold (p.17), and the Underwriting minimum score (p.31). Items 11 (IRS 1.42-17 feasibility evaluation), 12 (discretionary basis boost conditions) and 16 (broadband for HOME and NHTF) are program mechanics or apply only to other GOAL funding sources, and are not extracted. Labels TR.n follow the plan's own numbering, so the gaps at 11, 12 and 16 are deliberate.

criteria.heading: No supplemental funding while prior awards are tied up
criteria.quote: No supplemental funding request while prior year(s) awards are tied up in a project.
criteria.note: An applicant whose funded project has a gap must return the prior award and reapply for the whole amount.

criteria.heading: Construction and thermal standards
criteria.quote: All new construction projects must be in compliance with 15 AAC 154.090 construction

criteria.heading: No T1-11 or board and batten siding
criteria.quote: No T1-11, board and batten, or similar type of wood siding may be used on any exterior

criteria.heading: Market study
criteria.quote: All low-income housing tax credit project proposals must have a completed and

criteria.heading: Community support
criteria.quote: The project must demonstrate acceptable community support which must be evidenced
criteria.note: Letters of support from the local government and community councils.

criteria.heading: Units equipped for physical and sensory disabilities
criteria.quote: All new construction projects with 5 or more units must provide a minimum of 5% of the
criteria.note: 5% of units equipped for physical disabilities in new construction of 5+ units, and 2% for sensory impairments in any project of 5+ units, in separate units. 2.c scores going beyond this.

criteria.heading: Special needs set-aside
criteria.quote: For all projects with 20 or more units, 5% of total units (fractional units round down) must
criteria.note: 5% of units in projects of 20+ for a special needs population not already required by the funding source. 3.c scores units beyond it.

criteria.heading: Applicable construction standards and laws; NHTF new construction only
criteria.quote: Proposals funded through the NHTF are limited to new construction.

criteria.heading: Complete application package; responsible bidder
criteria.quote: Applicant is considered to be a “responsible bidder.”

criteria.heading: Reasonableness and feasibility review
criteria.quote: Reasonableness of the project’s development and operational data will be assessed
criteria.note: Includes the Schedule of Real Estate Owned, which AHFC uses to 'help score and determine the feasibility' of proposed cash flows (p.14).

criteria.heading: Energy Star appliances
criteria.quote: GOAL funded projects will be required to exclusively use certified

criteria.heading: Secured entryways
criteria.quote: Projects with units accessible through common hallways must have secured entryways.

criteria.heading: Children's recreation area
criteria.quote: all projects with eight (8) or more units, serving families with children must have a recreation area on-site for children
criteria.note: Families with children means any building with units of three or more bedrooms.

criteria.heading: No income averaging
criteria.quote: Income averaging will not be allowed for LIHTC projects.

criteria.heading: Project team and sponsor capacity at pre-application
criteria.quote: Proposals will not be invited forward into the full application
criteria.note: Developer experience within 10 years with the same or similar funding, two years of sponsor financial statements, and property management experience with the same or similar regulations.

criteria.heading: Minimum underwriting score
criteria.quote: An application must receive at least 8 of the total possible points in this category to
criteria.note: 8 of the 40 Underwriting points; the p.38 summary labels it '8 point threshold'. Alaska states no minimum overall score.
